input.quote: (vi) Transition Assistance. With regard to Termination Products in countries for which the licenses to Sanofi are terminating, Sanofi shall provide the following transitional assistance, with costs allocated as set forth below:
input.rationale: Article XII's exit machinery is entirely one-directional: Section 12.3(c)(vi) and its sub-paragraphs A-I impose transition assistance, Know-How transfer, regulatory transfer and inventory transfer obligations on Sanofi in favour of RevMed, and Section 12.3(d) (termination by Sanofi for safety, RevMed's material breach or insolvency) gives Sanofi only a reverse licence with no assistance or data return. The only RevMed-side assistance is the narrow Section 12.3(e) mechanic, which applies solely on termination for a Change of Control of RevMed by a Major Biopharmaceutical Company, is undefined as to duration, and carries no data export deadline. Section 11.6 is a destruction-on-request provision for Confidential Information, not a return or export of Sanofi's data, and sets no fixed period. There is therefore no usable Vendor-side transition and data-return clause anywhere in the Agreement, so we insert the fallback position (at least 90 days of assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination) as a new Section 12.3(f), which survives under Section 12.4. We did not flag the Sanofi-side transition obligations, which run against us.

proposal.summary: Insert a RevMed-side transition assistance and data return provision in Section 12.3
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The exit mechanics in Section 12.3 run only one way: Sanofi transitions everything to RevMed, but RevMed owes us no transition assistance and no return of our data on expiry or termination. We have added a short reciprocal provision at our fallback position (at least 90 days of assistance and export of our data within 30 days); our preferred position is six months of assistance at then-current rates with certified deletion after return.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Return by RevMed. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, RevMed shall, at Sanofi's request, provide Sanofi with reasonable transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and shall, within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to Sanofi all data belonging to, supplied by, or generated or processed for Sanofi.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
